config.whatsAppDefaultMessage: Hello Mr. Clarity, my name is [Name] from [Department]. I would like to join The Auspicious Era movement.
config.heroBio1: My name is Onifade Sulaiman, popularly known as Mr. Clarity. I am a Computer Science student, student leader, digital strategist and community builder passionate about helping students find clarity, discover opportunities and create meaningful progress.
config.heroBio2: The Auspicious Era represents a chapter of service, ideas and impact — built around what students can experience, access and achieve together.
config.beyondNameSubtitle: Before leadership comes identity. Before a position comes purpose.
config.whoIsIntro: Onifade Sulaiman, popularly known as Mr. Clarity, is a Computer Science student at Olabisi Onabanjo University whose journey has grown through academics, student representation, digital innovation, entrepreneurship, technology and service.
config.whoIsPhilosophy: The name "Mr. Clarity" comes from a simple idea: people make better decisions when they have better information and better understanding.
config.storyHeadline: I DIDN'T START WITH A TITLE. I STARTED WITH A DESIRE TO HELP.
config.storyQuote: A position ends. A legacy can continue.
storyParagraphs: My journey through university has not been a straight line.
I have had to learn, adapt, take responsibility, make mistakes, serve people, build skills and continuously figure out what direction I want my life to take.
Along the way, leadership became one of the ways I could contribute to the people around me.
But leadership also taught me something important: a position is temporary. What you build, what you teach, the people you help and the opportunities you create can last much longer.

config.turningPointHeadline: LEADERSHIP SHOULD NOT END WITH A POSITION.
config.turningPointIntro: During my time serving as General Secretary and class representative, one realization changed my perspective on student leadership completely:
config.turningPointRealization: Too often, student leadership focuses entirely on getting into office. Once the tenure ends, the impact ends. The manifestos are forgotten, the group chats go silent, and students are left with the same issues.
config.turningPointConclusion: I realized that real leadership is not defined by whether you hold an office today. It is defined by what you leave behind for tomorrow. That is why The Auspicious Era was created — as an enduring legacy tenure.
config.legacyTenureHeadline: More Than A Title. Something Students Can Actually Benefit From.
config.legacyTenureIntro: The Auspicious Era is designed around five strategic pillars that directly improve student experience, career readiness, and day-to-day campus life.

legacyInitiatives.title: TECHNOLOGY & DIGITAL TOOLS
legacyInitiatives.summary: Building modern digital tools, centralized resources, and online systems to make university life simpler and information readily available.

legacyInitiatives.title: SKILLS, CAREER & OPPORTUNITIES
legacyInitiatives.summary: Connecting students with high-value digital skills, internship opportunities, tech masterclasses, and freelance career paths.

legacyInitiatives.title: COMMUNITY, UNITY & INCLUSION
legacyInitiatives.summary: Fostering collaboration, healthy relationships, and a vibrant community where every student feels seen, heard, and supported.

config.humanSideHeadline: BECAUSE EVERY STUDENT HAS A STORY.
humanSideLines: Behind every matric number is a student with dreams.
Behind every grade is a struggle that exams never test.
Behind every quiet face is someone trying to figure things out.
Leadership should never forget the person behind the matric number.
config.humanSideConclusion: Leadership should remember the person behind the number.

config.whyEraHeadline: WE CANNOT CONTROL EVERYTHING ABOUT UNIVERSITY. BUT WE CAN BUILD AN ERA WE ARE PROUD OF.
whyEraParagraphs: "Auspicious" means promising, favorable, and full of potential for success.
The Auspicious Era is not a political campaign. It is an intentional chapter of student life centered on clarity, meaningful service, shared growth, and lasting impact.
When students support students, when information is shared freely, and when leadership creates actual opportunities, everyone wins.
config.whyEraCallout: AN ERA OF CLARITY. AN ERA OF IMPACT. AN ERA BUILT TOGETHER.
config.philosophyQuote: Clarity creates direction. Direction creates progress.
